verdict.rationale: Apify's docs confirm it supports Playwright/Puppeteer/Selenium/Crawlee for building custom Actors, and SessionPool manages cookies/proxies for persistent sessions, which together enable interactive, stateful browser control needed for clicking/filling forms behind a login wall. However, there is no concrete first-party or community example showing a login-wall workflow (session reuse across page interactions, form-fill after initial scrape) being demonstrated end-to-end. missing for 10: explicit login-wall/form-filling example, dedicated documentation on maintaining an already-open page/session across multiple interactive steps, independent corroboration of this specific use case.
